0.original: Alisaie is nodding approvingly at the sutlers.

49.original: Hardly surprising. Where there is war, there is profit to be had.

52.original: If you need to buy anything, now might be a good time.

53.original: Come to take the measure of our friendly neighborhood merchants?

54.original: They're a bold lot, that much is plain. If the imperials found out they were peddling their wares to the Resistance, they would be lucky to escape with their lives.

55.original: 'Tis a gamble, aye, and I admire their courage. But their motives could hardly be said to be altruistic...

56.original: Ah, here you are. I've been looking all over for you.

57.original: We've finished discussing your proposal, and we're ready to receive you all back at the tent.

58.original: I've sent someone to fetch Y'shtola and Krile, so if you'd like to follow me...

59.original: We'll begin once the others arrive.

60.original: Sorry to have kept you waiting, but matters such as these demand due deliberation.

61.original: What a relief! For a moment there, I really wasn't sure which way it was going to go...

62.original: Krile and I shall remain here for now. Should you have need of us, you are welcome to visit.

63.original: I briefly dabbled with similar methods involving distillations and infusions of herbal extracts, but I must confess to knowing little and less of Ala Mhigan traditional medicine. Would that I knew more, for its effectiveness exceeds all expectations...

64.original: Now that we've dealt with the formalities, we can get to work. I'm glad you're with us, friend.

65.original: Heh! As if there were any doubt!

66.original: Pinch me if I'm dreaming, because I'd swear it's finally happening. The whole of Eorzea, committed at last to the liberation of Ala Mhigo!

67.original: Right, then. M'naago and Meffrid are to be our keepers.

68.original: Knowing naught of what they require, one task is as good as the other. Make your choice, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>.

69.original: Your <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>aether compass<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> may now be used to locate aether currents in new regions! The aether compass can be found under Collection in the Duty section of the main menu.
